source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 34 (questions: PDF pages 96–97, solutions: PDF pages 170–172)

questions.prompt: What was the day of the week on 1 June 2001?
questions.rule: Count the odd days (days left over after whole weeks). 2000 whole years have 0 odd days. In 2001: January 3, February 0, March 3, April 2, May 3, and 1 June adds 1.
questions.working: 3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 12 odd days, and 12 = 7 + 5. Counting 0 = Sunday, 5 is Friday

questions.prompt: How many days are there in 6 weeks and 8 days?
On what date in January 1601 did the first Saturday fall?
questions.rule: 1600 whole years have 0 odd days, and 1 January adds 1, so 1 January 1601 was a Monday (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday).
questions.working: Monday is the 1st, so the first Saturday is 5 days later: 6 January

questions.prompt: If the 6th day of a month is a Friday, what day of the week is the 14th day of the month?
questions.rule: Days 7 apart fall on the same weekday.
questions.working: 14 − 6 = 8 days = 1 week + 1 day, so one day after Friday: Saturday

questions.prompt: Today is Sunday. What day will it be after 78 days?
questions.rule: Only the days left over after whole weeks matter.
questions.working: 78 = 11 × 7 + 1, so one day after Sunday: Monday

questions.prompt: Rajesh celebrated his birthday on 14 March 2022, a Monday. On which day of the week will he celebrate his birthday the next year?
questions.rule: From 14 March 2022 to 14 March 2023 is 365 days (February 2023 has 28 days).
questions.working: 365 = 52 × 7 + 1, so one day after Monday: Tuesday

questions.prompt: 1 December 1991 was a Sunday. Which date was the fourth Wednesday of December 1991?
questions.rule: 1 December is a Sunday, so the first Wednesday is 4 December.
questions.working: The Wednesdays are 4, 11, 18 and 25, so the fourth is 25.12.1991

questions.prompt: Which year after 1991 has exactly the same calendar as 1991?
questions.rule: Two years share a calendar when the odd days between them add up to a whole number of weeks, and neither (or both) is a leap year. An ordinary year adds 1 odd day, a leap year adds 2.
questions.working: 1991 to 2001: 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 14 odd days = 2 weeks. So 2002 starts on the same day as 1991, and neither is a leap year

questions.prompt: If the day before yesterday was Saturday, what day will the day after tomorrow be?
questions.rule: The day before yesterday was Saturday, so yesterday was Sunday and today is Monday.
questions.working: Tomorrow is Tuesday, so the day after tomorrow is Wednesday

questions.prompt: In a 30-day month that begins on a Saturday, every second and fourth Saturday and every Sunday is a holiday. How many working days are there in that month?
questions.rule: Day 1 is a Saturday, so the Saturdays are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and the Sundays are 2, 9, 16, 23, 30.
questions.working: Holidays: 5 Sundays + the 2nd and 4th Saturdays (8 and 22) = 7, so 30 − 7 = 23 working days

questions.prompt: The last day of a century can be a:
questions.rule: 100 years have 5 odd days, so the 1st century ends on a Friday. 200 years (10 = 3 odd days) end on a Wednesday, 300 years (15 = 1) on a Monday, and 400 years (0) on a Sunday.
questions.working: A century can only end on a Monday, Wednesday, Friday or Sunday. Of the options, only Friday

questions.prompt: How many leap years are there in a period of 100 years?
questions.rule: Every 4th year is a leap year: 100 ÷ 4 = 25. But a century year is a leap year only if it divides by 400.
questions.working: In an ordinary century the 100th year is not a leap year: 25 − 1 = 24

questions.prompt: How many days are there from 26 January 1996 to 15 May 1996?
questions.rule: Count both days: 26–31 January is 6 days. 1996 is a leap year, so February has 29. Then March 31, April 30 and 1–15 May.
questions.note: The book counts both 26 January and 15 May. Counting only the days after 26 January gives 110.

questions.prompt: Virat went to the market 10 days ago. He goes to the market only on Sundays. What day of the week is today?
questions.rule: Ten days ago was a Sunday.
questions.working: 10 = 7 + 3, so today is 3 days after Sunday: Wednesday

questions.prompt: Kiran was born on 5 March 2000. That year, Republic Day (26 January) was on a Wednesday. On which day of the week was Kiran born?
questions.rule: From 26 January to 5 March 2000: 5 more days in January, 29 in February (2000 is a leap year) and 5 in March.
